chapter.verse: Itna mah sulzuih unla kha thuphate, a diakin kamsan theih ding, deihpi-in nei un.
Banghanghiam cihleh kamtuam a pau mi pen mihing' tunga thugen hilo a, Pasian' tunga thugen ahih manin kuamah in ama' thugen thei lo uh hi. Amah ahihleh kha tawh thusimte a genkhia ahi hi.
A langkhat ah kamsanna a nei mi pen mite' tungah kilambehna, thapiakna leh hehnepna thu a gen ahi hi.
Kamtuam a pau mi pen amahmah a kilambeh hi a, kamsanna a nei mi ahihleh pawlpi a lambeh ahi hi.

Tu-in note na vekun kamtuam na pau theih ding uh kong deihsak a, ahi zongin kamsanna na neih ding uh kong deihsakzaw lai hi. Kamtuam a pau khat pen kamphen khat in pawlpi kilambeh nadingin a phensak leh cihloh, kamsanna a nei mi mah thupizaw hi.
Tu-in sanggamte aw, note' kiangah kampau kong pau zongin mangmuhna, thutheihna, kamsanna, hilhcianna cihte khatpeuh tawh kong thuah keileh note bangci bangin hong phatuamsak thei ding ka hi hiam?
Nuntakna neilo, a gingthei nate ahi tamngai leh harp khausai cihte zong tua dan mah hi a, aw namtuam tawh a gin kei uhleh bang la-aw kimut kitum cih kua in tel thei ding ahi hiam?
Pengkul zong aw namtuam tawh a gin keileh galkuan dingin kua kiging thei ding hiam?
Tua dan mahin note zong teltum om lo kam na pau uhleh kua in a kigen thu tel thei ding ahi hiam? Huihlaka pau na bang lel ding uh hi.
Leitung ah kampau nam tampi om kha mah ding a, tuate pen khiatna neilo zong om lo hi.
Himah taleh a kipau khat a khiatna ka theih keileh thugen mi' ading gamdang mi ka bang lel ding a, amah zong kei' ading gamdang mi mah bang lel ding hi.
Tua dan mahin note zong Kha hong kilatkhiat ding thalawp na hih zah khatun pawlpi kilambehna lam thadimtak hanciam un.
Tua ahih manin kamtuam a pau mi in tua kam a phenkik theih nading zong thu a nget ding ahi hi.
A hang pen kamtuam tawh thu ka nget leh ka kha in a ngen hi a, ka lungpilna in kimanna nei lo hi.
Bangci hih le-ing hoih ding hiam? Ka kha tawh thu ka ngen ding a, ka lungpilna tawh zong ka ngen ding hi. Ka kha tawh pahtawina la ka sa ding a, ka lungpilna tawh zong ka sa ding hi.
Tua hikeileh na kha tawh hehpih na phat ciangin tua muna om a pualam mi khatpeuh in na thugen thei lo ding ahih manin na lungdamkoh thu, bangci bangin, “Amen,” hong ci thei ding ahi hiam?
A hang pen nang' lam pan limtak mah hehpih a phat na hiding a, ahi zongin midang khat' ading kilambehna piang lo hi.
Note khempeuh sangin kamtuam pau theizaw ka hih manin Pasian' tungah lungdam ka ko hi.
Himah taleh pawlpi sungah midangte ka thuhilh theih nadingin kamtuam tawh kammal then khat genkhiat ding sangin keima' lungpilna tawh kammal nga genkhiat ding ka utzaw hi.
Sanggamte aw, na thungaihsutna uhah naupangvai kei un. Tua sangin gitlohna lamah naungek bang unla, na thungaihsutna uhah picing un.
“Theih ngeiloh kam a pau mite leh namdangte' muklekam tawh hih mite ka hopih ding a, tua nangawn ka thugen hong ngai lo lai ding uh hi, Topa in ci hi,” ci-in thukhun sungah kigelh hi.
Tua hi a, kamtuam pen thu-umlo mite' thu-up nading lim hi-in thu-um mite' ading hilo hi. Kamsanna ahihleh thu-um mite' kilambeh nading lim hi-in thu-umlo mite' ading hilo hi.
Tua ahih manin pawlpi bup kikhawmin vekpi-in kamtuam a kipau tek laitak a pualam mite ahihkeileh thu-umlo mite hong lut hileh no teng lungsim a maanlo hong ci ding uh hilo ahi hiam?
Ahih hangin vekpi-in kamsangin na om uh laitak thu-umlo mi khat ahihkeileh a pualam mi khat hong lut hileh na vekpi-un a mawhna kiphawksak thei-in na vekpi mahun thu na dongtel thei ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin a lungsim sunga a selcip thute hong kilangkhia ding ahih manin a maitang puksukin Pasian bia ding a, note lakah Pasian om taktak hi ci ding hi.

Tua ahihleh sanggamte aw, koici hih ding i hi hiam? Na kikhop uh ciangin mi kim in phatna la khat tek, hilhcianna khat tek, mangmuhna khat tek, kamtuam khat tek, ahihkeileh kamphenna khat tek, na nei uh hi. Na khempeuh kilambeh nadingin hih un.
Kamtuam tawh a pau a om leh nih ciang bek, ahihkeileh a tampenin thum ciang bek, khatkhit khat kikhelin pau uh henla kamphen zong om ta hen.
Ahih hangin kamphen ding a om keileh pawlpi sungah daitak om tek uh henla, khat ciat amah kia ahi-a Pasian tawh ahi zongin kiho hen.
Kamsang nihlethum in gen uh henla, a dangte in tua a kigen thute khentel uh hen.
Tua taka tu mi dang khat tungah thu a kilaakkhia a om leh thugen masa pen dai hen.
A hang pen mi khempeuh' tel dingin leh noptuam a ngah theih nadingin na vekun khatkhit khat kamsanna a nei thei na hi uh hi.
Kamsangte' kha pen kamsangte' khutnuai-a om hizaw hi.
Pasian pen buaina Pasian hilo-in nopna lemna Pasian ahi hi. Mi siangthote' pawlpi khempeuh in a zuih mah bangin
pawlpi sungah numeite a gamdaih ding uh ahi hi. A hang pen ukna nuai-ah a om ding uh Thukhun in zong gen ahih manin amaute a pau ding uh kiphal lo hi.
Numeite in theihnop a neih uhleh inn ah a pasalte' kiangah dong ta uhhen. A hang pen pawlpi sungah numei a paukhiat ding zumhuai hi.
Tua lo-in zong note' kiangpan Pasian' thu hong kipankhia ahi hiam? Ahihkeileh note' tung beka hong tung ahi hiam?
Kamsang, ahihkeileh Kha Siangtho a nei khatin a kingaihsun peuhmah in tu-a kong gelh thute Topa' thupiak hi ci-in a lak ding ahi hi.
Hih thu a thusim lo peuhmah kithusim lo ding hi.
Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, kamsanna nakpi lunggulh unla, kamtuam pauna na kham kei un.
Na khempeuh kilawmtakin leh ahi ding bangin hih un.
